rows.text: "Welcome to the city of St. Domingo! We sell cheat codes here." The mechanical attendant explains without a care in the world. "The kind you were definitely crazy about when you were little. What we have is slightly different, as they are the St. Domingo version."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Use it any way you want. Just make sure you don't get caught by the mechacops," it giggles.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Want both Cosmic Fragments and Curios.
You make a bold gamble! Who knows what will happen next?
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
